title: On Computational CUDA Studies of Black Hole Shadows
summary: Combining high-performance CUDA numerical codes with the Hamilton--Jacobi formalism, we investigate the shadows properties of rotating charged Euler--Heisenberg black holes in the presence of global monopoles. Then, we discuss the associated energy emission rate by varying the involved black hole parameters. As a result, we show that both the shadow structure and the energy emission rate depend on the global monopole parameter, the electric charge, and the rotation parameter.
